page_note: 本页为《2024 UN E-Government Survey》第66页，上半为正文段落，下半为图2.25：一张由上下两组、共七个面板构成的水平堆叠条形图，展示2022与2024年及五大洲各弱势群体在线服务比例。

heading.title: Percentage of countries offering services for people in vulnerable situations that can be completed partially or fully online, 2022 and 2024

figures.source_line: Sources: 2022 and 2024 United Nations E-Government Surveys.

components.evidence: each row bar carries a dark 'Fully digitalized' segment followed by a lighter 'Available' segment, e.g. '21%' then '52%'
category names 'Immigrants', 'Older people' sit at the left and bars extend rightwards
no ticks or baseline numbers anywhere; every quantity is only the printed '21%', '52%' text
'26%', '50%' printed on top of the dark and light segments of each bar
Africa and Oceania rows: '6%', '4%', '14%' labels overflow the very narrow dark segments
'2024', '2022' above the top blocks; 'Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Oceania' above the lower blocks
'Fully digitalized   Available' repeated above every one of the seven panels
the 'Fully digitalized / Available' word pair sits between each panel title and its bars
category names printed once at the left of each block and shared by the panels to the right
hue marks the region: green 2024, grey 2022, orange Africa, purple Americas, yellow Asia, blue Europe, teal Oceania
Oceania 'Women' row shows only '71%' in the light segment; no Fully digitalized segment or number
'Sources: 2022 and 2024 United Nations E-Government Surveys.' printed under the framed plot
long names such as 'Persons living below poverty line' run the full width of the left label column
title opens 'Percentage of countries offering services...'; no unit sits on any axis

new_components.name: full_scale_track_behind_bar
new_components.evidence: a pale grey track of equal length behind every bar, marking the unreached remainder to 100%
new_components.why_it_matters: 灰色底槽本身不是数据，读数时必须只量彩色段，否则会把整条底槽误当作某个数值。

new_components.name: numeric_change_column_between_panels
new_components.evidence: 'Percentage change since 2022' column of bare text values -13.5%, 2.7%, -8.3%, -1.3%, -8.6%, -1.9% between the 2024 and 2022 panels
new_components.why_it_matters: 该列只有数字没有图形，且既非2024也非2022面板，需要单列标签才能唯一定位。

new_components.name: panel_group_header
new_components.evidence: '193 UN Member States' printed above the 2024/2022 pair, naming the whole upper block
new_components.why_it_matters: 上组两面板共享一个全球范围标题，缺它就无法区分全球行与区域行的同名类别。

spot_checks.mark: the 2024 'Immigrants' Fully digitalized segment (also printed four times in the Oceania panel)
the 'Youth' entry in the Percentage change since 2022 text column
the Asia 'Older people' Fully digitalized segment
appears six times; e.g. the Europe 'Older people' Available segment (also Americas Immigrants, Americas poverty line, Europe poverty line, Asia Women, Europe Youth Fully digitalized)
the 2024 'Persons with disabilities' Available segment (also 2024 Women, Africa disabilities, Americas Women)

difficulty_notes: 数值全部印在段内，读数不成问题（第2步无风险）；难在定址：图内 '21%' 出现5次、'51%' 出现6次、'54%' 出现4次，唯一定位一条数值必须同时给出面板（2024 / 2022 / Africa…Oceania，外加 '193 UN Member States' 这一组标题）、系列（Fully digitalized 或 Available）和行名（如 Persons with disabilities）三到四个键；而 'Percentage change since 2022' 那一列既无系列也不属于任一区域面板，需要第四类键。普通解析器往往把七个面板拉平成一张表，行名重复六次而列头只剩 Fully digitalized/Available，面板维度丢失后 51% 无法与其它五处区分。

suggestions.where_to_change: 记录字段中为每个数值增加 panel 维度，条件行区分'同一系列名在七个面板重复'
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有/无 panel_key 时，对同一系列名重复出现于5个以上面板的图，数值定址准确率对比

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 full_scale_track_behind_bar（条后满量程灰槽）
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段增加'背景轨道'开关，用于水平堆叠条
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 绘制/不绘制灰色满量程轨道时，模型是否把轨道误读为第三个数据段

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 numeric_change_column_between_panels（面板之间的纯文本变化列）
suggestions.where_to_change: 版面条件行：在两个面板之间插入一列只有文本的派生数值
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 含/不含纯文本派生列时，该列数值（如 -1.9%）能否被表格行正确命名

suggestions.what_to_add: no_value_axis + value_label_inside 的组合以及标题内单位（Percentage of countries）
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段：数值标签位置与单位位置；标题字段拆出 unit
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 无值轴且单位只在标题时，导出表格是否保留百分号与单位语义

suggestions.what_to_add: missing_value_marker（Oceania Women 缺 Fully digitalized 段）
suggestions.where_to_change: 记录字段允许某系列在个别类别为空，并在渲染时留白
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 含缺失段的堆叠条中，缺失位是否被错填为相邻数值
